quote: Hypoformer consistently outperforms recent lightweight stateof-the-art methods under various parameter scales and speed scales. Achieving similar performance on three tasks, Hypoformer can compress Transformer base model  2.9 ∼ 4.5×, and speedup it 1.9 ∼ 3.3× on Intel CPU and 1.8 ∼ 3.9× on Raspberry Pi ARM CPU. Notably, when the parameter scale is extremely low, Hypoformer achieves a 7.1 higher BLEU score and 1.27× speedup than Transformer on IWSLT'14 De-En task.
